condition: Polycystic ovary syndrome with irregular periods

patient_persona.description: Nur Amira binti Zakaria, 23, female, fresh graduate working in a Cyberjaya call centre, irregular periods since university. Chatty, self-conscious about weight and acne, Malay-English Manglish.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ong Li Ting, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, family medicine doctor at a Putrajaya clinic. Friendly and clear; English with Malay words.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hi Amira, what brings you in today?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, my period very tak menentu. Sometimes three months tak datang, then bila datang, banyak sangat. Last one was in June.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. Any other changes? Berat badan, jerawat, bulu tumbuh on the face or tummy?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Weight naik almost ten kilo since uni. Jerawat pun teruk, and ada bulu halus kat dagu, I kena pluck every week. So malu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. Any chance mengandung? Just need to ask, okay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No lah, doctor, I'm single. Tak pernah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. Your BMI is 29, blood pressure 124 over 78. I see some darker skin at the back of the neck, which can go with insulin resistance.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, that one I thought daki, saya gosok kuat-kuat pun tak hilang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's acanthosis, bukan kotoran. All together, this sounds like PCOS, polycystic ovary syndrome. We'll confirm with blood tests and an ultrasound.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: PCOS? My cousin also got. She said susah nak mengandung. Is that true?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It can make it harder, but ramai perempuan with PCOS get pregnant, kadang-kadang with a bit of help. Bukan mandul, okay?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll check hormones, sugar, cholesterol and thyroid. Untuk haid dan jerawat, pil macam Diane-35 boleh bantu. Also metformin 500mg if your sugar is borderline.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Pill tu makan hari-hari ke? Will I gain more weight?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: One tablet daily for 21 days, then rehat seven days. Most people tak naik berat much. Weight loss of even five percent can bring periods back.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Five percent means around four kilo? Okay, that one I can try. I'll start jogging dekat tasik Presint.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's a good start. Kurangkan air manis and nasi, more protein and vegetables. See you in two weeks with the results.

patient_persona.description: Lee Xin Yi, 16, female, Form 4 student in Kajang, accompanied by her mother who waits outside. Shy, speaks softly, sometimes looks at the floor.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Tay Siew Ching, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, GP at a Kajang family clinic. Gentle, relaxed; Mandarin with English and school-slang Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Xin Yi，妈妈说你每个月 period 来的时候，痛到要请假，对吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 对……第一天和第二天最痛，痛到在床上滚，还会想 muntah。上个月在学校还 pengsan。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 痛的地方是下面的肚子，还是腰也会痛？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 下面肚子，还有腰。有时候痛到 thigh 这边。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Period 是几岁开始的？每个月准时吗？Flow 多不多？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 十二岁开始。很准时，二十八天左右。量普通，第一天要换 pad 比较多。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你平时痛的时候吃什么 medicine？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 妈妈给我吃 Panadol，可是没有什么用。还有喝红糖姜茶。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 姜茶可以继续喝，没有坏处。这种痛叫 primary dysmenorrhoea，very common in teenagers，通常不是什么严重的问题。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 可是我 classmates 都没有那么痛，为什么我这么严重？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 每个人的 prostaglandin 不一样，有些人比较多，就会比较痛。我给你 mefenamic acid 500mg，就是 Ponstan。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 最重要的是，start the tablet 一开始就吃，或者前一天就吃。一天三次，饭后吃，最多吃三天。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 饭后吃……那如果早上来不及吃 breakfast 呢？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 至少吃几片 biskut 或者喝 Milo 才吃药，不然胃会痛。热水袋放在肚子上也有帮助。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好。那 PE 课可以上吗？Cikgu 每次都叫我跑步。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 轻松的 exercise 其实会帮助减轻痛。如果还是很痛，我可以写 letter 给学校。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，谢谢医生。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 吃了三个月还是一样痛，或者 flow getting heavier，就要回来，我们做 ultrasound 看看。

patient_persona.description: Hasnah binti Mat Isa, 45, female, canteen operator at a secondary school in Pasir Mas, Kelantan. Frank, energetic but tired lately, Kelantanese Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lim Boon Kiat, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, medical officer at a Kelantan district hospital gynae clinic. Calm; speaks fluent Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Hasnah, dalam referral letter dari klinik kesihatan, haid puan banyak sangat. Boleh cerita sikit?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, dah enam bulan dah. Every period more than one week. Hari kedua ketiga, pad kena tukar setiap satu jam, pakai dua lapis.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada keluar ketulan darah? Besar macam mana?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada, macam hati ayam. Kadang-kadang sampai bocor ke kain masa kerja kat kantin. Malu betul.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan rasa penat, pening, atau sesak nafas bila naik tangga? Letih sangat?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Penat sangat, doktor. Dulu saya boleh angkat periuk besar, sekarang sekejap je dah tercungap-cungap.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hemoglobin puan 8.1. Normal untuk perempuan atas 12. So puan ada anaemia sebab banyak hilang darah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Patutlah muka pucat, anak saya pun tegur.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ultrasound tadi ada satu fibroid kecil, tiga sentimeter, in the wall of the womb. Mungkin itu sebab haid banyak.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Fibroid tu barah ke, doktor? Saya takut.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bukan barah. Fibroid ni ketulan otot, sangat biasa pada umur macam puan. Tapi kita akan buat biopsy lapisan rahim sekali, sebab puan dah lebih 40, just to be safe.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Masa haid, makan tranexamic acid 1 gram, three times a day, maximum four days. Dia kurangkan darah haid.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kena makan hari-hari ke, doktor? Every day?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Masa haid je. Untuk darah, ferrous fumarate 200mg dua kali sehari, sekurang-kurangnya tiga bulan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat besi tu buat saya sembelit dulu. Constipation teruk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Makan lepas makan, minum air banyak, makan betik. Kalau sembelit sangat, beritahu saya, kita bagi stool softener.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau ubat tak jalan, kena operation ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada pilihan lain dulu, macam Mirena, alat dalam rahim yang ada hormone. Kita bincang lagi lepas keputusan biopsy, dalam dua minggu.

condition: Endometriosis with painful periods and subfertility

patient_persona.description: Rachel Fernandez, 32, female, Eurasian, hotel sales manager in Melaka, trying to conceive for eighteen months. Articulate, frustrated, a little tearful.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Suresh Nair, Malaysian Indian man in his 50s, O&G consultant at a Melaka private hospital. Measured, kind; English with a few Malay words.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Rachel, I've read your GP's letter. Painful periods for years, pain during intercourse, and eighteen months trying for a baby. Betul?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, doctor. The pain started when I was a teenager, but the last three years dah jadi teruk sangat. Even Ponstan tak jalan anymore.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any pain when opening your bowels during your period?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, actually. I never told anyone because malu sangat. It's like a stabbing pain, macam kena tikam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's an important clue. On examination, there's tenderness behind the uterus, and the ultrasound shows a 4 cm cyst on the left ovary, what we call an endometrioma.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Is it cancer? My aunt had ovarian cancer.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The appearance is typical for endometriosis, which is not cancer. We'll check a blood marker, CA-125, but it's often mildly raised in endometriosis anyway.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So endometriosis is why I tak boleh mengandung?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's a common reason. The tissue causes inflammation and scarring around the tubes and ovaries. Your husband's semen test was normal, which helps.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: What can we do? I don't want to wait anymore, doctor. Everyone at family gatherings keeps asking, bila nak ada baby, bila nak ada anak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'd recommend a laparoscopy, keyhole surgery. We remove the cyst and the endometriosis spots, and check whether the tubes are open with dye.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Will surgery affect my eggs? Saya dah 32, doctor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: There's some risk to the egg reserve, so we'll check your AMH level first. If it's already low, we may go straight to IVF instead.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. And for the sakit in the meantime?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Naproxen 500mg twice a day during your period. Since you're trying to conceive, we won't use hormones now.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you for explaining properly. Other doctors just cakap period pain is normal, tahan je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Severe pain isn't normal, and you did right to push. Come back in one week with the blood results, and bring your husband.

patient_persona.description: Wong Siew Fong, 48, female, runs a family hardware shop in Taiping, Perak. Straightforward, busy, Cantonese-flavoured Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Norhafizah binti Ghazali, Malay woman in her 40s, gynaecologist at a Taiping hospital. Efficient, kind; English with Mandarin and Malay phrases.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Auntie Wong, your scan shows several fibroids. The biggest one is about 9 cm. 很大哦.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 九公分？难怪我的肚子这么大，人家还以为我 pregnant。晚上也要起来 urine 三四次。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, the fibroid is pressing on your bladder, 压到膀胱, so you feel like urinating often. Any constipation?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有啊，常常便秘。还有月经很多，最近 blood test 说我 anaemia, hemoglobin low.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your hemoglobin is 9.4. Fibroids are not cancer, 不是癌症, but at this size with these symptoms, we should treat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要开刀吗？我 kedai 走不开，我老公一个人顾不了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: There are a few options. Since you're 48, and menopause usually comes around 50 to 52, some women just wait with medicine, 等 menopause.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: But because of the size and the bleeding, most would choose surgery. Either buang fibroid sahaja, or remove the whole womb, hysterectomy.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我不要再生孩子了，两个儿子都大了。拿掉子宫会不会很快老，会不会像我姐姐那样很热很烦？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If we keep the ovaries, 保留卵巢, your hormones continue normally. Menopause comes at its natural time.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那 operation 要住院多久？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Open surgery, about three to four days in ward, and six weeks rest from heavy lifting. Tak boleh angkat barang berat, okay?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 六个礼拜不能搬东西……我的 kedai 都是搬 cement 和 paint 的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your husband or a worker will need to help. Before surgery, I'll give iron tablets to raise your blood, ferrous fumarate 200mg twice a day.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好吧，我回去和老公 discuss 一下，next week I give you the answer。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. If the bleeding becomes very heavy, with giddiness, go to emergency, 不要等.

condition: Menopause with hot flushes and sleep disturbance

patient_persona.description: Rohani binti Said, 52, female, government office clerk in Kuala Lumpur, periods stopped fourteen months ago. Warm, a little flustered, laughs at herself.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Jasmine Kaur, Malaysian Punjabi woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist at a KL health clinic. Friendly, direct; speaks Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Rohani, apa masalah hari ni?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, saya ni panas je sepanjang masa. Kat ofis orang lain pakai sweater, saya berpeluh sampai tudung basah. Malam pun terjaga sebab berpeluh.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sehari berapa kali rasa panas tu datang? How many times?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak terkira, doktor. Sepuluh kali kot. Malam paling teruk, tidur pun tak lena, esok pagi mengantuk kat ofis.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Haid last bila?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dah lebih setahun tak datang. Saya ingat lega lah, tak payah beli pad, rupanya datang masalah lain pulak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ini hot flushes, very common menopause symptom. Ada rasa sakit masa hubungan suami isteri, atau kering di bahagian bawah?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada juga, kering. Suami pun dah perasan. Malu nak cakap sebenarnya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa, ni semua perkara biasa. Mood macam mana? Cepat marah, sedih?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Cepat marah! Anak-anak kata mak sekarang garang macam singa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada pilihan rawatan. Hormone replacement therapy, HRT, paling berkesan untuk hot flushes. Tapi saya kena check dulu risiko puan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kakak saya kata HRT tu boleh sebabkan kanser payudara. Betul ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Risikonya kecil, especially if used less than five years. Tapi kita check mammogram dulu, dan pastikan tak ada sejarah darah beku atau strok.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya tak pernah buat mammogram. Tak ada sejarah strok.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: OK, saya rujuk mammogram dulu. Lepas tu kita mula tibolone 2.5mg sekali sehari, atau HRT combined. Untuk kering tu, krim estrogen faraj dua kali seminggu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sementara tunggu, ada apa-apa saya boleh buat? Any tips?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pakai baju kapas nipis, kipas kecil kat meja, kurangkan kopi dan makanan pedas. Senaman ringan pun membantu tidur.

condition: Perimenopause with irregular bleeding and mood changes

patient_persona.description: Shanti a/p Govindasamy, 47, female, secondary school English teacher in Klang. Expressive, speaks in long sentences, Malaysian Indian English with Tamil-influenced rhythm.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Hafiz bin Rahmat, Malay man in his 40s, family physician at a Klang private clinic. Patient, good listener; English with some Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, I don't know what's happening to me. My period come every two weeks sometimes, then skip two months. And I cry at small things, even in class, depan students.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That sounds really tough, Shanti. How long has this been going on?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: About one year already. At first I thought stress, because of SPM students. But now also got night sweats, berpeluh satu badan, and I cannot tidur properly.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: At 47, these changes fit perimenopause, the years before periods stop completely. Hormone naik turun, jadi haid dan mood susah nak jangka.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So it's normal? I'm not gila lah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: You're definitely not going crazy. But because the bleeding is irregular, saya nak pastikan tak ada benda lain, like polyps or thickened lining.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: When you bleed, is it heavy? Any bleeding after intercourse?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sometimes heavy, with clots, ketul-ketul. After intercourse no.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll arrange a pelvic ultrasound and blood tests, full blood count and thyroid. Your last Pap smear?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Five years ago, I think. Masa my daughter's wedding time.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We'll do one today. About the mood, do you still enjoy things, or feel hopeless most days?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Not hopeless. Just very emotional, and my husband says I'm always marah-marah. Tapi I still enjoy my gardening, tanam bunga.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's good. Regular exercise, sleep routine, less caffeine will help. If the flushes are bad, low-dose hormones can smooth things out.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Can I take evening primrose oil? My ipar swears by it, dia kata very good.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The evidence is weak, but it's generally harmless. Don't spend too much on it. Let's see the scan first.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, doctor. Terima kasih for listening. I feel better already just talking.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Come back in two weeks with results. Kalau darah banyak sangat, tukar pad setiap jam, terus pergi emergency.

condition: Postmenopausal osteoporosis after a wrist fracture

patient_persona.description: Chua Ah Moi, 64, female, retired tailor in Batu Pahat, Johor; fractured her wrist two months ago slipping in the kitchen. Talkative, Hokkien-flavoured Mandarin, worries about costs.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kenneth Yeo Chee Hong, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, orthopaedic medical officer at a Batu Pahat hospital. Patient; Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 阿姨，你的 bone density，就是骨质密度的报告出来了。T-score 是负三点一。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 负三点一是什么意思？很 serious 吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 负二点五以下就是 osteoporosis，骨质疏松。That's why a small slip caused a fracture，因为骨头已经很脆了。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我妈妈以前也是这样，后来弯腰驼背，走路要拿 tongkat。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 骨质疏松会遗传。你停经是几岁？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 四十五岁左右，比较 early。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 早停经也是一个原因。我给你开 alendronate 70mg，一个礼拜吃一次。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一个礼拜一次？那很方便。要怎么吃？Before or after food？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个药吃法很重要。早上起床空肚子，配一大杯白开水，然后坐着或站着，三十分钟不能躺下，也不能吃东西。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 为什么不能躺？会 choke 吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果躺下，药会停在食道，会伤到食道，很痛。还有不能配 kopi 或牛奶一起吃。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 明白。那钙片要吃吗？我在 pharmacy 看到很多种，很贵。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 要吃。Calcium carbonate 加 vitamin D，每天一粒，和 alendronate 分开时间吃，比如晚上吃。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 这个药要吃多久？Government hospital 有没有给？我不想买太贵的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 医院会给，你只要付挂号费。Usually five years，然后再 check 骨密度。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我在家要注意什么？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 厨房地板要干，bathroom 放防滑垫。每天走路晒太阳半个钟，多吃 tauhu、ikan bilis 这些含钙的东西。

condition: Genitourinary syndrome of menopause with recurrent urinary symptoms

patient_persona.description: Maimunah binti Harun, 61, female, retired kindergarten teacher in Kuala Kangsar, Perak. Polite, soft-spoken, embarrassed about the topic.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kamala Devi a/p Rajoo, Malaysian Indian woman in her 50s, family medicine specialist at an Ipoh clinic. Warm, unhurried; fluent Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cikgu Maimunah, apa khabar? Saya tengok dalam rekod, tahun ni dah tiga kali dapat jangkitan kencing.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Betul, doktor. Setiap kali makan antibiotic, baik sekejap, lepas tu datang balik. Pedih masa kencing, selalu nak ke tandas.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Selain tu, ada rasa kering atau gatal kat bahagian faraj?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada... kering sangat. Kadang-kadang pedih walaupun tak buat apa-apa. Nak cakap pun segan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak perlu segan, cikgu. Ini sangat biasa lepas menopaus. The estrogen level drops, kulit kat bahagian tu jadi nipis dan kering.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tapi saya dah menopause lebih sepuluh tahun. Kenapa baru sekarang?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dia memang makin teruk dengan masa. Kulit nipis tu buat kuman senang masuk saluran kencing, sebab tu jangkitan berulang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya periksa sekejap ya. Memang nampak nipis, merah sikit, tapi tak ada ketulan atau luka yang mencurigakan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah. Jadi treatment dia macam mana, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya bagi krim estrogen, estriol, sapu kat dalam. Every night for two weeks, lepas tu dua kali seminggu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hormone? Tak bahaya ke, doktor? Kawan saya kata boleh dapat kanser.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Krim ni dos sangat rendah, kerja setempat je, sangat sedikit masuk darah. Dia selamat untuk kebanyakan wanita.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau macam tu, saya cuba. Ada benda lain saya patut buat?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Minum air sekurang-kurangnya lapan gelas sehari. Jangan tahan kencing lama. Guna sabun lembut, jangan guna pencuci wangi.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Air kencing hari ni pun rasa pedih sikit. Kena makan antibiotic lagi ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ujian urine hari ni nitrite positif. Saya bagi nitrofurantoin 50mg, empat kali sehari, lima hari. Lepas tu kita harap krim ni kurangkan jangkitan.

patient_persona.description: Catherine Lau Mei Fong, 51, female, accountant in Georgetown, Penang, periods stopped nine months ago. Precise, has researched online, a bit sceptical.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Azura binti Mohd Salleh, Malay woman in her 40s, O&G specialist at a Penang private hospital. Evidence-focused, calm; English.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, I've done my reading. I have hot flushes, brain fog at work, and my joints ache. I want to know if HRT is worth the risk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good that you've read up, Catherine. Let's go through your own risk profile, because that's what matters, bukan statistics semua orang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any history of breast cancer in the family, blood clots, stroke, or heart disease?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My mother had breast cancer at 68. No clots, no stroke. My father had a heart attack at 70.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Do you smoke? Blood pressure today is 132 over 84, and your BMI is 24. Mammogram last year was normal?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Never smoked. Mammogram last year clear, BIRADS 1. Semua okay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. For women under 60, or within ten years of menopause, benefits usually outweigh risks when symptoms are troublesome.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: But my mother's breast cancer, doesn't that change things? 我有点担心.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It raises your baseline risk a little. Combined HRT adds a small extra risk, about one extra case per thousand women per year of use.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: That's smaller than I expected. What about clots? Darah beku?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: With a patch or gel, estrogen through the skin, the clot risk is not increased like with tablets. That's what I'd suggest for you.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. And I still have my uterus, so I need progesterone also, right? Two hormones.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Correct. Micronised progesterone 100mg at night, every night. It protects the lining.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: How long can I stay on it? Selamanya?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We review every year. Many women use it for five years, then taper. We'll keep yearly mammograms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alright, I'm willing to try. If I get bleeding, macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Some spotting in the first three to six months is common. Bleeding after that needs a scan, so let me know.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Fair enough. Terima kasih for giving me numbers, not just "it's safe" or "it's dangerous".
